rule_or_requirement: An actual extracted submission-format ZIP must satisfy runtime limits and improve valid completion and lap time on independent confirmation cells.
observable_information: Exact ZIP hashes, isolated import/create/reset/act and RSS metrics, matched finish/lap/progress/collision/damage/intervention traces.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Read-only extraction and local execution of the frozen candidate and selected control ZIPs on registered confirmation cells; no policy change or upload.
expected_success_endpoint: Candidate completion at least control, zero invalid/runtime violations, gas activation, and at least 2% lower jointly completed median lap.
falsifier: Archive or runtime violation, fewer candidate finishes, invalid action, no gas activation or less than 2% paired median lap improvement.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Twelve matched untouched confirmation cells, tracks 1–3 × seeds 5212–5215, two exact ZIPs.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered 1,800-second Linux CPU confirmation process, 2,000 decisions per episode; no site upload, official submission or model confirmation.
